title: DUO: Dual Readouts of Diffusion Models for OOD Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.13304v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models are powerful generative methods for learning and sampling from complex data distributions. Safely deploying these models requires detecting inputs that fall outside their training distribution. Because diffusion models recover clean samples from noisy inputs, reconstruction error is often used for out-of-distribution (OOD) detection. This approach assumes that in-distribution (ID) inputs are reconstructed more accurately than OOD inputs. However, OOD inputs may be reconstructed equally well or even better, making this score unreliable. We therefore propose the leading sensitivity spectrum of intermediate denoising features as a complementary OOD signal and demonstrate that it remains informative when reconstruction error is misleading. We introduce DUal-readout of diffusion models for OOD detection (DUO), a fully unsupervised, training-free OOD detector that combines reconstruction error and feature sensitivity. DUO im

translated_title: DUO：基于扩散模型双读出的分布外检测方法
translated_abstract: 扩散模型是一种强大的生成方法，可用于从复杂数据分布中进行学习和采样。安全地部署这些模型需要检测超出其训练分布的输入。由于扩散模型从噪声输入中恢复干净样本，重构误差常被用于分布外（OOD）检测。这种方法假设分布内（ID）输入的重构精度高于OOD输入。然而，OOD输入可能被重构得同样好甚至更好，使得这一评分变得不可靠。因此，我们提出将中间去噪特征的主导敏感度谱作为补充性的OOD信号，并证明当重构误差产生误导时，该信号仍能提供有效信息。我们提出了用于OOD检测的扩散模型双读出方法（DUO），这是一种完全无监督、无需训练的OOD检测器，它将重构误差与特征敏感度相结合。
tldr: 提出了一种完全无监督、无需训练的OOD检测方法DUO，通过将重构误差与中间去噪特征的主导敏感度谱相结合作为双重信号，即使重构误差产生误导时也能可靠地检测分布外输入。
en_tdlr: DUO is a fully unsupervised, training-free OOD detector that combines reconstruction error with the leading sensitivity spectrum of intermediate denoising features, enabling reliable out-of-distribution detection even when reconstruction error alone is misleading.
